name: Improved Arrows
summary: Sniper and Rapid Fire deal 25% more damage to enemies that are slowed or burning.

name: Stronger Walls
summary: Base max HP +20, and the base is repaired by 20 HP.

name: Advanced Traps
summary: Splash hits slow enemies by 20% for 1.5 s.

name: Gunpowder
summary: Splash and Heavy towers deal 15% more damage.

name: Heavy Armor
summary: Enemies reaching the base deal 25% less damage (at least 1).

name: Fire Technology
summary: Splash and Heavy hits set enemies on fire: 8% of the hit per second for 2.5 s, ignoring armor. Stops regeneration.

name: Ballistic Research
summary: All towers +10% range, +2 armor penetration.

name: Automated Weapons
summary: Focus fire: a tower that stays on one target for 2 s attacks 25% faster.

name: Advanced Explosives
summary: Splash blast radius +20%. Heavy shots stun for 0.4 s (bosses immune).

name: Plasma Technology
summary: All towers +4 armor penetration. Energy weapons break shields twice as fast.

name: AI Targeting
summary: Every tower sees cloaked enemies. Rapid Fire gains +15% critical chance.

name: Energy Shield
summary: At the start of every wave the base gains a 20 HP shield.

name: Trappers
summary: Doctrine. Every slow lasts 50% longer.

name: Hunters
summary: Doctrine. All towers deal 25% more damage to enemies above 80% health.

name: Incendiary
summary: Doctrine. Splash hits burn (8% of the hit per second for 2.5 s), and a burning enemy that dies sets its neighbours on fire.

name: Cryo Shells
summary: Doctrine. The third slow on an enemy within 4 s freezes it for 0.8 s (bosses immune; no new freeze for 6 s).

name: Field Engineers
summary: Doctrine. Towers knocked out by bosses recover 40% sooner, and restarting one at once costs half.

name: Overpressure
summary: Doctrine. Stunned or frozen enemies take 20% more damage from everything.

name: Tesla Coils
summary: Doctrine. Chain lightning (Rapid Fire level 6) jumps to 2 more enemies.

name: Target Painter
summary: Doctrine. Heavy's Expose also marks every enemy right next to the target.
